slides.title: The same, typed
slides.html: The daily work has commands too, for those who script. They work the same with the downloaded file, typed in its folder, as with the install from a terminal.

slides.title: Point it at Fleet
slides.html: These slides show Fleet: set its address, the token file, the team, such as golden-monkey DeployApp, and your Deploy App's name. The token is read from that file, never typed on the line.

slides.title: Set the team up
slides.html: The first time, paste the settings line into ODMDM_CHALLENGE as shown, run odmdm-connector apply, then unset it. Your team gets the certificate, the policy, the apps and the Deploy App icon.

slides.title: A new opening
slides.html: odmdm-connector challenge asks for the settings line you copied, without showing it, and gives your MDM the new challenge.

slides.title: List the phones
slides.html: odmdm-connector phones lists the phones: each phone's number, callsign and certificate.

slides.title: Name them
slides.html: name --all OTTER numbers every waiting phone. Or choose each: name 33=OTTER3 34=OTTER4.

slides.title: Ask again
slides.html: odmdm-connector resend asks again for every named phone that was refused or failed.

slides.title: Send the policy again
slides.html: apply --force-policy sends the policy to every phone again: the fix for Certificate Authentication Failed on a phone that has its certificate. Not while phones are still installing apps.
